description.value:
A frame with a dull coppery sheen that produces strange temporal effects.

Bullet Time (2 PP): As a reaction, attempt to dodge a ranged attack (DC 15 + attacker's CR or tier).

Temporal Pulse (4 PP): Create an 80-foot radius effect that grants allies an extra move action or denies enemies theirs (Will save DC 12 + half mech tier).

A mech can have only one starmetal frame system.
